extraFacts.fact: Inverted flare ends follow SAE J512, a 45° flare connection.
JIC ends are the SAE J514 / ISO 8434-2 37° flare connection, sealing metal-to-metal on the flare seat.
NPTF is the Dryseal tapered pipe thread of SAE J476, which seals on the thread.
